entries.title: A long press on a task on iPhone and iPad offers what your Mac's Tasks list offers
entries.body: On iPhone and iPad, a long press on a task in Tasks now offers at least what resting the pointer on the same task offers on your Mac. A finished or dropped task, which offered only Open record, can now be pinned and unpinned there too. A task in Backlog offers Start, or Try again after a start that failed, which starts it at once as on your Mac, and a held task can be started from it.
entries.noPicture: The desktop's hero recipe cannot take a picture of the phone's menu; the phone check's pictures of it stay with the change.
